#  44501 - Apparatus-Design 1 Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **44501 - module is no longer offered from WS 2012/13**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Apparatus-Design 1**  |  
|  Apparatetechnik I   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 4 - Environmental Sciences and Process Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Witt, Werner 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Vessels, heat exchanger, columns   |  
| Contents:  | a) Theory of strength of materials to design pressure vessels, case studiesb) Layout, heat exchanger, evapourater and condenser, case studiesc) Layout of absorption and distillation columns (tray and packing), case studies   |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Strongly recommended: Fundamentals of thermodynamics, heat - and mass transfer   |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Lecture notes Simulation software (Chemcad)   |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | Written report, presentation, examination 90 min   |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment
